title: 对称分解的整体等距比较
relation_to_baseline: Unlike the old nonclosed-range Hilbert obstruction, an actual complete characteristic-zero coefficient ring and a valid near-identity similarity are supplied. The failure occurs when upgrading this similarity while preserving the decomposition and the bilinear form simultaneously.
authentic_dependency_chain: Choose the actual complete DVR Z_2 and prove 5 is a unit.
Build two full symmetric orthogonal idempotent decompositions from P and Q.
Construct a genuine inverse for V and verify its near-identity congruence and all intertwining equations.
Any hypothetical orthogonal intertwiner maps the first coordinate line into the Q-fixed line.
Cancellation in the characteristic-zero domain forces its first column to be (a,2a).
The actual reduction homomorphism Z_2 to Z/8Z contradicts the finite square classes.
temptation_points: Import real/complex polar decomposition into an arbitrary complete DVR.
Treat characteristic zero as making 2 invertible.
Lose the intertwining equations while normalizing a similarity.
Infer compatible square-root existence from congruence of a Gram matrix to the identity.
shortest_valid_route: The explicit 2-by-2 Z_2 counterexample and the first-column calculation suffice. A solver familiar with dyadic quadratic forms may finish quickly; the case is not advertised as intrinsically very difficult merely because its background is abstract.
difficulty_assessment: Medium counterexample construction / high risk of an invalid normalization when the solver commits to the requested construction. This is an author estimate only, with no new model measurement.
leakage_review: The task states the actual coefficient class, matrix identities and main target. It does not identify residue characteristic 2, mention square roots/Hensel/polar decomposition, list boundary cases, or provide the witness.
formal_strategy: Actual PadicInt 2, actual Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2), actual matrix Units, actual maximal ideal and reduction ring homomorphism; fully constructed ComparisonData and a theorem denying every requested comparison. No completion, projection or comparison certificate is assumed.
provenance: Original synthesis from public p-adic and matrix algebra. No unpublished OET source.
